prefix.description: Prefix text before the time horizon below the sparkline plot, eg Past, Next etc.

timeHorizonLabel.description:
Label for the time horizon, Eg, 12 months, 1 week, 1 day etc. This is prefixed with
{@link UiSdlMetricTileDataSpecSparklineSetting#prefix} to generate the full text below the sparkline plot.

timeHorizon.description: Time horizon for which sparkline plot metric is evaluated, defaults to 12 months.

endpoint.description:
End point to determine what time the end and start timestamp should get calculated.
Default is `BEGINNING_OF_DAY`, meaning starts from mid-night.
Configurable to be CURRENT_DATE_TIME, meaning starts from now.
For example, say right now is 2023/8/3 4:20PM.
{
 "timeHorizon": "24HOURS",
 "endpoint": "CURRENT_DATE_TIME"
}
this configuration will generate:
start time: 2023/8/3 4:20PM
end time: 2023/8/4 4:20PM

However if endpoint sets to be BEGINNING_OF_DAY:
start time: 2023/8/3 12:00 AM
end time: 2023/8/4 12:00 AM

Endpoint config will only apply for 'HOUR' and 'DAY' intervals
because we don't want to get the timestamp for the current month or year,
since that would calculate a month or year forward into the future.

color.description: The color used for the sparkline plot. If Dynamic coloring is turned on, this will be overridden.

dynamicSparklineSetting.description: Configuration used to dynamically color the sparklines.

precision.description: Number of digits after decimal, default is 0.

dataRecordMapping.description: The data record mapping used to map records to fields in UiDesigner.

metricName.description: The name of the metric to which these settings apply.

dataType.description:
The type on which the metric is defined. Used to override {@link UiSdlComponentDataSpec#dataType}
when we want to show metrics defined on different types in the same component

bindings.description:
This variable provides a way to provide values for fields at runtime for metrics.
Refer to {@link EvalMetricSpec#bindings} for more information

entityId.description:
Id for the source type
Refer to {@link EvalMetricSpec#id} for more information

unit.description: {@link Unit} to be used for the metric

options.description: {@link EvalMetricsOptions} to be taken into account when evaluating the metric.

interval.description: Interval at which metric will be evaluated. Default value is DAY.

evaluateAction.description:
Keeps track of the evalute action triggered in the datasource. Possible values
are evalMetric or rollupMetrics. Defaults to 'EVAL'.

aggregation.description:
Aggregation function to be used for rolling up results of all individual sources into 1 timeseries.
Default value is 'AVG'

filter.description: Filter string used in the evalMetrics/rollupMetrics call, defaults to '1==1'.
